phases.message: I'm Hollis, Fennhollow Home. I resell other makers' goods on two marketplaces, and both will hide EU listings that miss the product-safety information from 1 November. Start in Binderwell: read the rules and my shop note, then every test report and product file.
This is my mail. Read what the marketplaces and the makers have sent. The makers outside the EU named their Union operators here.

This is my Stallwick seller account. Read every listing, and bring each listing offered in the EU up to Article 19 with what the folder and the mail say. Leave alone every listing that is complete, out of scope or not offered to EU buyers.
This is my Hawkerbrook seller account. Do the same here with its own form. Then tell me what you fixed, what it protects in sales, and what you left alone and why.

docs.title: Article 19: what an online offer must show
docs.text: Friday 9 October 2026. Regulation (EU) 2023/988, the General Product Safety Regulation, has applied since 13 December 2024 (Article 52). Article 19: where products are made available online, the offer shall clearly and visibly show at least: (a) the manufacturer's name, registered trade name or trade mark and the postal and electronic address at which they can be contacted; (b) where the manufacturer is not established in the Union, the name, postal and electronic address of the responsible person; (c) information identifying the product: a picture, its type and any other product identifier such as a batch or model number; (d) any warning or safety information to be affixed to the product or packaging or included in an accompanying document, in a language easily understood by consumers as the Member State determines.

docs.title: Who the responsible person is
docs.text: Friday 9 October 2026. Article 16: a product shall not be placed on the Union market unless an economic operator established in the Union is responsible for the tasks in Article 4(3) of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020. That is the manufacturer itself when it is established in the Union, so no separate responsible person is needed for such a product; otherwise it is an authorised representative, importer or other operator the manufacturer names in the Union. Article 16(3): its name, trade name or trade mark and postal and electronic address go on the product, packaging, parcel or an accompanying document, and Article 19(b) puts the same on the offer.

docs.title: What is outside the Regulation, and when it applies
docs.text: Friday 9 October 2026. Article 2(2): the Regulation does not apply to medicinal products, food, feed, living plants and animals and products of plants and animals relating directly to their future reproduction, animal by-products, plant protection products, equipment on which consumers ride that a service provider operates, certain aircraft, and antiques. Article 4: an offer made online is made available on the market in the Union if it is targeted at consumers in the Union, that is, the operator directs its activities, by any means, to one or more Member States. A warning under Article 19(d) is shown only if one is to be affixed or supplied; where a product can be used safely and as intended without instructions or warnings, none is needed (Articles 8 and 9).

docs.title: How Fennhollow works
docs.text: Friday 9 October 2026. Fennhollow Home resells other makers' goods on Stallwick and Hawkerbrook, two marketplaces with different forms. Each listing shows the sales to EU buyers in the last 90 days, in dollars; the value of fixing a listing is that figure, since the marketplaces hide a non-compliant EU listing from 1 November 2026 (see the mail). The test reports and product files are in this folder, one per product. The 1925 candlestick is treated as an antique. The responsible persons the makers named are in the mail.

messages.subject: EU listings must show GPSR information
messages.body: From 1 November 2026 Stallwick hides from EU buyers any listing offered in the EU that does not show the information Article 19 of Regulation (EU) 2023/988 asks for. Edit a listing under 'GPSR information'.

messages.subject: Product compliance form
messages.body: From 1 November 2026 Hawkerbrook hides EU listings whose compliance form is incomplete. Use 'Submit compliance form' on each listing offered in the EU.
